question: How much residual moisture did the water-processed NMC532 cathode lose between 20 °C and drying at 120 °C, and how does its final value compare with the NMP-processed cathode dried at 100 °C?
rendered:
According to the text, the water-processed NMC532 cathode initially contained 625 ppm of residual moisture at 20 °C. After drying at 120 °C, its residual moisture level was reduced to 47 ppm. 

In comparison, the NMP-processed NMC532 cathode initially contained 200 ppm of residual moisture at 20 °C, which was reduced to 87 ppm after drying at 100 °C. Therefore, the water-processed cathode lost 578 ppm of residual moisture, while the NMP-processed cathode lost 113 ppm of residual moisture.
